newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia building approvals fall in Nov.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia building approvals fall in Nov.

text.p: Australian dwelling unit building approvals fell a seasonally-adjusted 1.6 percent in November to 10,942 from 11,121 in October, compared with 10,245 in November 1995, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
Economists on average had expected building approvals to fall 2.0 percent.
The bureau said the seasonally adjusted number of private sector houses approved in November rose by 4.7 percent, while the number of other residential dwelling units approved fell by 11.3 percent.
The value of non-residential building, which has been particularly strong in recent months, leapt to A$1.68 billion from A$1.06 billion in October, seasonally adjusted.

The ABS said the trend value of non-residential building is showing strong growth with an increase of 40 percent over the last year. It includes the start of the Olypmic Games projects in Sydney. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
